### Times of Difficulty
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/times-difficulty
Passage: 2 Timothy 3:1
Points:
- Paul wrote his final letter to prepare Timothy and the church for enduring hardships and inevitable suffering in ministry.
- Believers should not be taken off guard by trials, since biblical prophecy long warned that the faithful would encounter trouble.
- The biblical concept of the "last days" spans the entire era from Christ's resurrection until His final return, encompassing our present day.
- Wickedness and heresy will persist until Christ comes back, meaning Christians must faithfully resist sin without despairing over the church's imperfections.

### Trouble in the Last Days
Author: Michael A. Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-september-22-2025.html
Passage: 2 Timothy 3:1-9
Points:
- Paul warned that the end times would be marked by immoral conduct, self-love, and hostility toward God's standards.
- Societal cruelty and selfishness cannot be healed by human laws or education, but solely through the transformative power of the gospel.
- Deceptive teachers exhibit an outward veneer of religion while rejecting the true power of holiness in their personal conduct.
- Even when facing fierce opposition to biblical doctrine, believers can remain steadfast knowing that Christ will soon return to bring righteous judgment.
